fixes.explanation: That's right, baker. John says, “Some of them wanted to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him.” (John 7:44). The wanting was there, but nobody followed through. That's some folks wanting to grab the dough and never getting a hand on it.
Yes, baker. The Pharisees say, “But this crowd that does not know the law—they are under a curse.” (John 7:49). Curse is the word the text gives them. You picked it right out of the batch.
